book.name: Job
book.title: Job Wotfo Gudbala Pipul Abum Trabul?

content: Job bin wandim im laif blanga jidan gudwan laik bifo
Wal Job bin kipgon tok,
“Ai wandim main laif blanga jidan gudwan laik bifo wen God bin oldei lukaftumbat mi.
En det lait blanga im bin oldei shoum mi det wei thru langa det dakbala pleis.
Langa det taim wen aibin jidan brabli strongbala men, det boswan God bin oldei jidan garram mi,
en ol main bigininimob bin oldei jidan gulijap langa mi.
Ol main kau en nenigout bin oldei gibitbat mi loda milk, en main olibtri bin gro en gibitbat mi loda oliboil.

“Wal aibin det kaunsala du. Aibin go en joinap garram det najalot kaunsala en yangwan lidamob en garram detlot olmen deya langa det taun, en deibin oldei rispek langa mi en deibin ol jandap wen aibin kaman,
en olabat bin ol jidan brabli kwaitbala.”
Ebribodi bin oldei shoum rispek langa Job
Wal Job bin kipgon tok, “Ebribodi bin brabli gudbinji wanim aibin tok en dum.
En wen ola powan pipul en ola biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi bin jinginat blanga sambodi blanga kaman en album olabat, aibin oldei go en album langa olabat.
Aibin album detlot hubin gulijap dai en aibin album detlot widogel du, en olabat bin ol tok theingkyu langa mi en deibin brabli gudbinji.
En aibin kain langa olabat en bin oldei gibitbat ebribodi feyago.
Aibin brabli kain langa ol detlot blainwan pipul en langa ol detlot leimwan pipul du.
Aibin jis laiga dediwan blanga ol detlot powan pipul, en aibin oldei deigim pleis blanga olabat langa kothaus blanga ol detlot hubin abum trabul, nomeda olabat bin streinja.
Aibin stapam detlot krulbalamen brom tridimbat pipul nogudbalawei, en aibin seibum olabat.
“Aibin reken ai garra jidan laibalawan en gudbinjiwei blanga longtaim, en ai garra binijap langa main ronwan sweig garram ol main femili en frenmob.
Langa det taim na aibin jidan brabli strongbala jis laik det tri weya im rut go raitdan langa bigismob woda,
o jis laik nyuwan bo en erro, en aibin brabli strongbala.
“Deibin oldei lisin langa mi wen aibin oldei toktokbat, en ola pipul bin oldei jidan kwaitbala wen olabat bin irrim wanim aibin oldei toktokbat.
En wen aibin stap tokin, nobodi nomo bin tok enijing. Deibin jinggabat rili ad blanga ol detlot wed weya aibin oldei toktokbat.
Det wed blanga main bin brabli gudwan langa olabat, jis laik det feswan rein weya meigim ebribodi gudbinji wen im kaman.
Wen pipul bin jidan sedwan aibin luk langa olabat hepiwei blanga meigim olabat fil gudwan, en ebribodi bin brabli gudbinji.
Aibin lidimbat olabat jis laik det king weya im oldei lidimbat im soljamob, en aibin meigim olabat brabli gudbinji.”
